home.orgDescription: HNUDAO is dedicated to connecting blockchain learning, technical practice, open-source collaboration, and campus exchange. Students interested in Web3, cybersecurity, open-source technology, and youth innovation are welcome to follow us.
home.orgPositionDesc: Organizing learning, sharing, collaboration, and open exchange as a campus tech community.
home.contentMethodDesc: The website serves as the unified showcase, with dynamic content synchronized to WeChat, X, and open-source platforms.
home.latestUpdatesDesc: Check out recent association news, public events, and project entries to quickly understand what HNUDAO is working on.
home.joinCtaTitle: Join HNUDAO — Learn, Share, and Build Together
home.joinCtaDesc: If you're interested in blockchain, open-source collaboration, technical content creation, or campus event organization, learn how to get involved here.

about.title: About
about.description: Learn about HNUDAO's positioning, vision, mission, organizational culture, and future direction.
about.introDesc: HNUDAO is the Blockchain Association at Henan Normal University, focusing on blockchain, Web3, cybersecurity, open-source technology, and student innovation. We aim to connect learning, research, sharing, and collaboration, helping more students enter real-world technical scenarios with lower barriers.
about.visionDesc: Build a campus blockchain community with technical depth, open atmosphere, and long-term collaboration capability.
about.missionDesc: Through public sharing, project practice, content accumulation, and peer collaboration, provide students with a platform for continuous growth.
about.cultureDesc: We aim to combine the open atmosphere of campus clubs with the collaborative approach of tech communities.
about.openCollabDesc: Encouraging cross-grade, cross-discipline cooperation. Students from all backgrounds are welcome to learn and build together.
about.techPracticeDesc: Emphasizing the transition from knowledge to real practice, creating a closed loop of sharing, projects, and retrospectives.
about.longTermDesc: Continuously accumulating content, projects, and experience, so each generation of members can build on the foundation of their predecessors.
about.futureDesc: The association will continue to expand around technical learning, content dissemination, project incubation, and internal/external collaboration.
about.futureItem1: Continue organizing public sharing, reading exchanges, and foundational technical learning activities.
about.futureItem2: Gradually accumulate project practices, knowledge resources, and open-source outcomes suitable for campus scenarios.
about.futureItem3: Explore establishing long-term collaboration with more students, clubs, and external communities.
about.timelineDesc: The development timeline is displayed chronologically, facilitating year-by-year documentation of association milestones.
about.ctaDesc: If you'd like to learn more about how to participate, follow upcoming events, or connect with us, continue here.

join.title: Join Us
join.description: Learn why to join HNUDAO, who it's for, common participation methods, and the recruitment process.
join.whyJoinDesc: Here, you can engage with real technical topics, participate in public sharing, meet like-minded peers, and improve your communication and practical skills through collaboration.
join.whoFitsDesc: Whether you're just getting into blockchain or already following Web3, cybersecurity, open-source projects, or tech communication — as long as you're willing to learn and collaborate, you're welcome.
join.deptAdviceDesc: Choose based on your interests: development, content, event organization, research sharing, or external partnerships. You can also adjust gradually through collaboration.
join.processDesc: Official recruitment information is based on the semester schedule. Below is the current standard participation process.
join.step1Desc: Follow the website, WeChat Official Account, and X to get recruitment and event updates first.
join.step2Desc: Once registration opens, submit your basic information, interest areas, and personal statement.
join.step3Desc: Through the interview, we learn about your interests, background, and time commitment, and help you understand the association's workflow.
join.step4Desc: After joining your chosen direction, participate in daily learning, content co-creation, event preparation, or project practice.
join.faqDesc: The following answers are the current public version. They will be updated with the semester schedule during official recruitment.
join.faq1Q: Can I join without relevant experience?
join.faq1A: Yes. We welcome students who are just starting out. We value interest, willingness to commit, and continuous learning ability.
join.faq2Q: How do I choose a department?
join.faq2A: We suggest making an initial choice based on your interests and available time. You can gradually find a better fit through actual collaboration.
join.faq3A: Registration typically opens in coordination with the semester schedule. Please follow the website, WeChat Official Account, and X for official announcements.
join.registerDesc: Registration is not yet open. Once it begins, this page will announce the registration method and schedule.
join.registerNote: Follow WeChat, X, or the website for upcoming recruitment and event notifications.
join.ctaDesc: If you'd like to learn more about the association's direction or stay informed, connect with us through official channels.

sponsor.title: Sponsor
sponsor.description: View HNUDAO's public on-chain sponsor addresses to support association activities, content building, and project practice.
sponsor.whyDesc: HNUDAO welcomes sponsorship from alumni, friends, community partners, and supporters. Your support goes toward public events, content publishing, infrastructure, and project practice.
sponsor.activitySupportDesc: For public sharing, workshops, community events, and related organizational costs.
sponsor.contentBuildDesc: For the website, resource organization, design materials, and public content publishing.
sponsor.projectPracticeDesc: For open-source projects, experimental tools, and long-term collaborative outcomes.
sponsor.infrastructureDesc: For domain names, hosting, development collaboration, and other essential services.
sponsor.noticeTitle: Please Confirm Chain & Address Before Transfer
sponsor.notice1: Each chain requires its corresponding network. Do not send cross-chain directly.
sponsor.notice2: Ethereum, Optimism, Base, BNB Chain, Polygon, and Arbitrum currently share the same EVM address, but you must confirm the correct network before transfer.
sponsor.notice3: For larger sponsorships, we recommend contacting the association via email first to confirm usage and receiving arrangements.
sponsor.walletsDesc: Click the copy button to quickly copy the corresponding network address. Please double-check the chain, currency, and address before initiating a transfer.
sponsor.ctaDesc: If you'd like to collaborate, understand sponsor usage, or confirm before transferring, please contact us via email first.

news.title: News
news.description: The news page displays content cards uniformly, linking directly to WeChat articles or external publishing pages.
news.categoriesDesc: Quickly browse association updates, event previews, announcements, and content updates by category.
news.allNewsDesc: Click a card to jump to the corresponding external publishing channel. News will continue to be updated.

activities.title: Activities
activities.description: The activities center displays event entries. Cards default to linking WeChat articles, event pages, or registration pages.
activities.statusDesc: Status is distinguished not only by color but also by text, for accessibility and maintenance.
activities.maintainMethodDesc: Activity entries can include registration links, WeChat article links, or other public URLs.
activities.currentNoteDesc: The activities page is currently used as a public publishing entry. Real activity notifications and registration will be integrated gradually.
activities.allActivitiesDesc: Activity cards link directly to external event pages or official notifications for unified maintenance and distribution.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: The projects page is for long-term accumulation of association projects, coursework, and open-source outcomes. Cards link directly to repositories or external demos.
projects.statusDesc: Projects support three statuses: planning, active, and archived — suitable for long-term maintenance and versioned accumulation.
projects.externalUrlDesc: Projects can link to GitHub repositories, demo pages, documentation, or other public demo addresses.
projects.currentNoteDesc: The current project page displays directions the association is building or planning. Real outcome links will replace them gradually.
projects.projectListDesc: Click a card to go directly to the project repository, demo address, or other public resource page.
